title: Advent Calendar Fishing Lures – 24 Lures Behind 24 Doors
seo_description: 24 fishing lures behind 24 doors: 8 spoons, 7 wobblers, 6 soft baits and 3 vibration lures. The Christmas gift for the one who already has everything in the tackle box.
descriptionHtml:
The gift for the angler is always the same guess

He has wobblers in three sizes, spoons he never uses and a box that won't close. The wrong reel gets a polite nod. A gift card says outright that you didn't know. And the closer it gets to the 24th, the more it leans toward socks again.

One lure a day right up to Christmas Eve

Behind every door sits a ready-made lure – a wobbler one morning, a spoon the next, a soft-bait shrimp the third. He turns it over in his hand, feels the weight and immediately thinks about where to try it. On December 24 a new tackle box stands ready, built one door at a time.

Features

  • Something to open every morning in December – 24 doors with a lure behind each
  • Four kinds of lures, not 24 of the same – 8 spoons, 7 wobblers, 6 soft baits and 3 vibration lures
  • Ready to tie on and fish with right away – hooks and split rings are already attached
  • The tackle box is stocked for the season opener in spring – the lures are meant to be out being tried, not left in a bowl
  • You don't need to know brands or sizes – the whole point is that he gets to try something he didn't choose himself

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
